blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present Isekai3D Synthetic Data Generation (SDG), a platform for simulating and capturing synthetic 3D gameplay for research in vision and world models, neural graphics, gameplay agents, and other applications. The platform combines reusable environment and character assets with Unreal Engine plugins in a two-stage workflow. First, world simulation generates gameplay while recording the world state, character movements, actions, and camera tracks needed for replay. Second, the recorded simulation is replayed to capture selected outputs, such as rendered video, images, and depth maps, at a specified resolution and frame rate under selected rendering and camera configurations. Separating simulation from capture allows the same recorded gameplay to produce multiple output variants without repeating the original simulation. Visual outputs are accompanied by frame-aligned camera, character, and action metadata. The platform uploads generated data directly in a training-friendly format, reducing intermediate storage, preparation time, and manual processing. This report describes the design of our overall system, including the platform's assets, plugins, and their functionality, explaining how they work together to generate diverse synthetic gameplay data.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍 Isekai3D 合成数据生成(SDG),这是一个模拟并捕获合成3D游戏机的平台,用于视觉和世界模型,神经图形,游戏机代理等应用的研究. 该平台将可重复使用的环境和字符资产与不真实引擎插件在两阶段的工作流程中结合. 首先,世界模拟在记录重放所需的世界状态,人物运动,动作,相机轨迹的同时生成游戏玩法. 第二,重新播放所记录的模拟,以获取选定的产出,例如制作的视频、图像和深度图,在选定的渲染和相机配置下,以特定分辨率和帧率进行。 将模拟从捕捉中分离出来,可以让相同的被记录的游戏游戏产生多个输出变体而无需重复原作的模拟. 视觉输出伴有相框相机,字符和动作元数据. 平台上传直接以便于培训的格式生成了数据,减少了中间存储,准备时间和人工处理. 这份报告描述了我们整体系统的设计,包括平台的资产,插件,以及它们的功能,解释了它们如何合作生成多样化的合成游戏游戏数据.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Interactive 3D gameplay provides a setting for studying how visual worlds
evolve and how actions influence them. For vision/world models and gameplay agents,
useful training data can include both rendered observations and the actions,
camera motion, and scene state associated with those observations. A shared
data platform must therefore support variation across environments,
characters, behaviors, and viewpoints while maintaining a consistent
relationship between visual sequences and their accompanying metadata.

以及行动如何影响它们。 对于视觉/世界模型和游戏代理商,
有用的培训数据可以包括提出的意见和行动,

因此,数据平台必须支持不同环境的差异,

视觉序列与其伴随的元数据之间的关系。

blocks.en:
Isekai3D SDG addresses this need by providing a platform for building large and diverse synthetic datasets of high-quality 3D gameplay.
The platform combines reusable environment and character assets with Unreal Engine plugins for gameplay behavior,
recording, and capture. This organization allows users to configure
data generation around a common asset collection and workflow, and to
extend individual components as their application requirements change.

blocks.en:
The workflow separates recording scene activity from capturing its visual
outputs. A recorded sequence can be replayed with different camera and
rendering configurations, allowing multiple observations to be generated

This enables diverse applications and use cases, as well as paired
data generation for training purposes.

and capture variants, supporting automated runs in both editor and

blocks.en: 2 Approach
blocks.zh: 2 方针

blocks.en: 2.1 Assets and Environments
blocks.zh: 2.1 资产和环境

blocks.en:
The Isekai3D SDG platform can support varying gameplay and environment categories.
In this report, we describe how we generate third-person (3P) gameplay
data.
We first describe the two key components of 3P gameplay: characters and environments.
blocks.zh:
Isekai3D SDG平台可以支持不同的游戏游戏和环境类别.
在本报告中,我们描述我们如何生成第三人称(3P)游戏游戏
数据。
我们首先描述了3P游戏游戏的两个关键组成部分:人物和环境.

blocks.en:
The character collection contains 500+ generated humanoids based on SMPL-X [ 2 ] and Grounded-Exo2Ego [ 3 ] .
We integrate these assets into Unreal Engine through IsekaiCharacters , our custom plugin that packages character
content as a reusable module.
Each character includes a skeletal mesh, materials, and a skeleton
using the same 55-joint SMPL-X layout, with an additional non-deforming
root bone for integration into Unreal Engine. The joint layout covers
the body, hands, jaw, and eyes. A shared animation retargeting setup
transfers motion from Unreal Engine’s Manny skeleton to the character
skeletons, allowing the animation library to be reused across the
collection. Characters support a shared library of locomotion and
gameplay animations for varied movement and actions.

blocks.en: 2.2 World Simulation and Recording
blocks.zh: 2.2 世界模拟和记录

blocks.en:
World simulation generates gameplay in a selected environment using
configured characters and behaviors. Our custom IsekaiSceneReplay plugin records the simulation using Unreal Engine’s replay system,
supplemented with timestamped player actions and camera trajectories,
while IsekaiGameplay supplies configurable gameplay actions and interactions.
Automated recording uses a fixed simulation timestep and can run without rendering through Unreal
Engine’s NullRHI mode, avoiding image-generation work until capture.
The recording stage produces an Unreal replay file containing replicated
world state and a companion JSON file containing timestamped character
positions, orientations, and velocities; camera poses and fields of view;
and simulated input events, including action presses, releases, and axis
values. These files retain the simulated activity for subsequent capture.
blocks.zh:
世界模拟在选定的环境中使用
配置字符和行为 。 我们的定制 IsekaiSceneReplay 插件记录了使用不真实引擎的重播系统的模拟,
以时间标记的玩家动作和相机轨迹作为补充,
而IsekaiGameplay则提供可配置的游戏游戏动作和互动.
自动录制使用固定的模拟时间步,可以不通过不真实的渲染而运行
引擎的无效 RHI模式,避免图像生成工作直到捕获.
记录阶段生成包含复制的不真实的重播文件
World state 和包含时间标记字符的 JSON 同伴文件
位置、方向和速度;照相机姿势和视野;
和模拟输入事件,包括动作压力、发布和轴
数值。 这些文件保留了模拟活动,供后续捕捉.

blocks.en:
An optional phantom simulation mode improves data generation performance by recording multiple independent character trajectories in a shared world simulation. Characters collide with the environment but do not collide with or otherwise affect one another; each capture renders only the selected character.
Sharing the recording stage across trajectories reduces repeated simulation work, with observed end-to-end throughput improvements of approximately 1.3 1.3 – 2 × 2\times , depending on the machine and workload. The benefit is greater when recording accounts for a substantial fraction of generation time; per-character behavior, animation, and capture still incur computation.
blocks.zh:
一种可选的奇幻模拟模式通过在共享的世界模拟中记录多个独立字符轨迹来提高数据生成性能. 字符与环境发生碰撞,但不相互碰撞或以其他方式相互影响;每个抓取只使选定的字符.
共享跨轨的录制阶段会减少重复的模拟工作,观测到的端到端的吞吐量改进约为1.3 – 2×2\时间,视机器和工作量而定. 当记录占到一代时间的很大一部分时,好处更大;每个特征的行为、动画和捕捉仍然需要计算。

blocks.en: 2.3 Capture and Data Outputs
blocks.zh: 2.3 采集和数据产出

blocks.en:
Capture uses the saved replay and timestamped tracks rather than rerunning
the autonomous behavior decisions. At each capture timestep, the system
restores the recorded character trajectory, samples the selected camera
track, and reconstructs the corresponding input and action state. This
provides deterministic sampling of the recorded camera, character, and
input timelines across capture runs using the same settings. The same
recording can therefore support different output resolutions and rendering
passes, while camera variants can be selected explicitly without repeating
the original world simulation.
blocks.zh:
抓取使用保存的重播和时间标记的音轨而不是重运行
自主的行为决定。 在每一个捕捉时间步,系统
恢复所记录的字符轨迹,样本所选相机
,并重建相应的输入和行动状态。 这个
对录制的相机、字符和
整个抓取的输入时限使用相同的设置运行。 一样
因此,记录可以支持不同的产出分辨率和渲染
通过,而相机的变体可以被明确选择而不重复
最初的世界模拟。

blocks.en:
Figure 3 illustrates nine capture outputs from the
same recorded frame and camera viewpoint, including RGB, depth, material
properties, world-space normals, irradiance, and instance IDs.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en:
Camera and projection settings allow the same recorded gameplay to
provide complementary observations without repeating the world
simulation. Third-person and first-person perspective views capture
character-level activity and the scene from the character’s viewpoint,
while top-down and isometric orthographic views emphasize spatial
layout and movement through the environment
(Figure 4 ). Additional projection modes include
360-degree equirectangular panoramas for capturing the surrounding
environment and 180-degree overhead fisheye views for wide-angle
coverage around the character (Figure 5 ).
Together, these options support datasets with varied viewpoints and
image geometries, including paired observations of the same recorded
activity with frame-aligned camera, character, and action metadata.

blocks.en:
Standard captures use hardware-encoded H.264 video with variable
bitrate (15 Mb/s target, 18 Mb/s configured maximum), packaged as MP4
without re-encoding. Path-traced captures use H.264 at CRF 6 with 8-bit
4:2:0 pixels ( yuv420p ). For perspective and orthographic views,
supported radiance passes can instead be stored losslessly as scene-linear
EXR frames, bypassing tonemapping and video compression.
Standard browsers and video libraries can inspect the MP4 files directly. A thin file-I/O adapter maps reads
to object-store range requests, allowing training to read selected clips
without first copying the full dataset locally.

blocks.en: 2.4 Dataset Format and Training
blocks.zh: 2.4 数据集格式和培训

blocks.en:
Preparing fixed training clips in advance incurs transcoding
and storage costs and ties the dataset to chosen resolutions, frame rates,
and clip lengths. Changing these choices can require another preparation
pass. Custom file formats can also make samples harder to inspect.
blocks.zh:
预先编写固定培训剪辑需要转换编码
和存储成本,并将数据集与选定的分辨率、帧率挂钩,
和剪辑长度。 改变这些选择需要另外准备
通过。 自定义文件格式也可以使样本更难检查.

blocks.en:
Isekai3D supports lazy datasets over stored videos and metadata.
Researchers select resolution, frame rate, clip duration, and filtering
criteria when launching training; clips are read and transformed on demand.
In our measured workflow, constructing a lazy dataset from 10,000 hours of
video took 3 minutes using Python. Copying the same amount of footage without
processing took 16 hours with a tuned copying utility. Reading and
transforming samples still incur cost during training.
blocks.zh:
Isekai3D在存储的视频和元数据上支持懒惰的数据集.
研究人员选择分辨率、帧率、剪辑持续时间和过滤
培训启动时的标准;根据需要阅读和转换剪辑。
在量度的工作流程中,从10000小时的
视频用了3分钟使用Python. 复制同样数量的镜头,而不包含
处理需要16小时,并配有调制的复制工具。 阅读和
转换样品在培训期间仍然产生费用。

blocks.en:
In another example, users were able to work with more than 30 lazy
datasets, often combining several in a training run. If each required a full copy at
the measured rate, 30 copies would take 480 aggregate hours, compared with
1.5 hours for 30 three-minute dataset constructions. This comparison
estimates preparation time under the full-copy assumption. Reusing the
stored videos also avoided hundreds of terabytes of duplicate storage.
blocks.zh:
另一个例子是,用户能够与30多名懒惰者合作。
数据集,经常在训练中结合多个数据集. 如果每份都要求在
30份需要480个总时数,相比之下,
30个三分钟的数据集构建1.5小时. 本比较
在全复制假设下估计准备时间。 重用该
存储的视频还避免了数百兆字节重复存储.

blocks.en: 2.5 Deployment and Extensibility
blocks.zh: 2.5 部署和扩展

blocks.en:
The full Unreal Engine development setup, including the project, assets,
and supporting tools, requires approximately 1 TB of disk space and
substantial setup effort. To make data generation accessible without this
development environment, we provide a packaged game that includes our
Unreal Engine plugins and assets, providing the full SDG functionality.
Levels are packaged separately, allowing researchers to
download the base application and only the environments needed for their
experiments. Automated recording and capture run directly against this
packaged game, without requiring an Unreal Engine installation or local
compilation. Runtime configuration and automation interfaces allow researchers to programmatically steer data generation and distribute varied experiments across multiple machines using the same packaged build.
blocks.zh:
完整的非真实引擎开发设置,包括项目,资产,
和辅助工具,需要大约1TB磁盘空间和
相当努力 使数据生成无需此功能即可访问
开发环境,我们提供 包装游戏,包括我们的
不真实的引擎插件和资产,提供了完整的SDG功能.
关卡是分开包装的,允许研究人员
下载基础应用程序,仅下载其所需的环境
实验 自动录制和捕获直接与此相对应
软件包游戏,无需安装不真实的引擎或本地
汇编。 运行时配置和自动化接口可以让研究人员在程序上引导数据生成,并利用相同的包件构建在多台机器上分配各种实验.

blocks.en:
A coding assistant can use the command-line tools and
configuration files to select environments and characters, download the
required content, set recording and capture options, and run generation
(Figure 6 ). It can then inspect the outputs and
adjust the configuration. SPEAR [ 5 ] also demonstrates
coding-assistant use with programmable simulators.

编码助理可以使用命令行工具和
用于选择环境和字符的配置文件,下载
需要的内容,设置记录和抓取选项,并运行生成
(图6). 然后可以检查产出和
调整配置。 SPEAR [5] 也证明
使用可编程模拟器进行编码辅助。

blocks.en:
Figure 6: Example workflow: a coding assistant selects content,
configures generation, and checks the outputs.
blocks.zh:
图6:示例工作流程:一个编码助理选择内容,
配置生成,并检查输出。

blocks.en:
The game uses a modular build in which components are distributed as
dynamic-link libraries (DLLs). Researchers can use a smaller Unreal Engine
project to compile modified versions of these components with compatible
engine and build tools, then use the resulting DLLs with the packaged
application. This supports custom functionality without requiring the
full environment collection and development project for each change.
blocks.zh:
游戏使用模块化架构,其中组件以
动态链接库(DLLs). 研究人员可以使用更小的不真实引擎
将这些组件的修改版本编译为兼容
引擎和构建工具,然后使用所生成的DLL和包装
应用。 这支持自定义功能而不要求
每项变化的完整环境收集和开发项目。

blocks.en:
We also provide an automated integration workflow for custom Unreal Engine
plugins. Researchers can add their own plugins to extend the SDG system
or reuse the platform’s assets in their own workflows. For example, the
external IsekaiGFMUI plugin adds configurable waypoint markers,
compass indicators, minimaps, and objective panels to captured gameplay.
Figure 7 illustrates these elements together,
showing how an external plugin can enrich rendered observations with
navigation and task information. Together, these deployment and extension
options support both users who need a ready-to-run data generator and
developers who want to adapt individual components independently.

blocks.en: 3 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 3 结论

blocks.en:
Isekai3D SDG presents a modular and extensible platform for synthetic data
generation of game and game-like scenes.
It builds on reusable assets and Unreal Engine
plugins in a shared environment for achieving flexibility and scale.
Separating world simulation and recording from capture allows
the same gameplay to be reused across camera configurations, resolutions,
and output types while retaining aligned metadata. The packaged application
makes data generation accessible without installing the Unreal Engine
editor, while custom plugins or DLL-based extensions allow researchers to
adapt functionality independently. Together, these
capabilities provide a foundation for creating datasets tailored to research
in world models, gameplay agents, and other applications.
